description: The rational-cut embedding preserves addition and negation.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalLower_add_neg (p q : ℚ) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalLower (p + q) =
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.cutAdd (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalLower p)
        (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalLower q) ∧
    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalLower (-p) =
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.cutNeg (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalLower p)
